# 🧩 Repository Templates

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Test plan](test-plan-template.md) | Define page checks and environments. |
| [Test report](test-report-template.md) | Capture actual results and evidence. |
| [Accessibility audit](accessibility-audit-template.md) | Document manual and automated accessibility checks. |
| [Bug report](bug-report-template.md) | Write a reproducible issue without sensitive information. |
| [Documentation review](documentation-review-template.md) | Review accuracy, links, and diagrams. |
| [Change request](change-request-template.md) | Scope proposed source changes separately from docs. |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Verify repository state before a tagged release. |
| [Screenshot evidence](screenshot-evidence-template.md) | Record browser and viewport metadata for real captures. |

Replace placeholders with actual values. Never represent unchecked steps as passing.
